transcript: This is the kind of show that encores! Was made for. An underrated, hidden gem of a musical that hasn't been seen in New York in over 60 years since its initial Broadway debut. This show happened to come in a really crowded Tony season, competing against the likes of Hello Dolly, Fiddler, Funny Girl. But now New York City Center is putting it back in the spotlight with an all star cast including real life husband and wife Steven Pasquale and Phillipa Soo. Katrina Lenk, Andrea Martin, freaking Rachel Dratch is in this? It is truly one of the most stacked cast City Center has ever assembled. The show itself is definitely weird and quirky. It is about a man, Stephen Pasquale's character, who is being haunted by his ex wife, played by Katrina Lenk. While I don't think this is a show that necessarily could be successful on Broadway today, I also think that's kind of what makes it the perfect City Center Encore show. Because despite its imperfections, there's a lot to appreciate about the show. There's a lot of really fun musical numbers, including one where Andrea Martin is singing to a Ouija board. That scene alone is worth the price of admission. And the book has a lot of really great gags and bits and a truly bonkers ending that I did not see coming. Now, a lot of recent encore shows have leaned more towards fully staged productions, many of them ditching the notion of scripts. On stage entirely. However, in this production, pretty much everyone is using a script for the majority of the show. No, I don't necessarily think that is a negative, and it's definitely given them a lot of time to play around and find these characters. But I do think it's important to properly set your expectations going into the show, because encores really hasn't done a show like this in a while, and this feels like them going back to their roots, and I could not be happier.
